# testing_x_client_filter (Resource)

XClientFilter Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_client_filter" "my_xclientfilter" {
  category = "...my_category..."
  name     = "my-filter"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the client filter resource

### Optional

- `category` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_client_filter.my_testing_x_client_filter
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_client_filter.my_testing_x_client_filter "..."
```
